prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production enemy sprite for Depths, a dark stressful first-person pixel dungeon crawler. Silhouette-led restrained pixel art, large crisp clusters, at most three broad shades per material, warm upper-left highlights and dark cool shadows. Flat sparse surfaces, no individual fur, veins smaller than a large readable mark, no pores/grain/noise, no gradients/dithering/antialiasing, no glossy rendering, no ground shadow, background or text. Serious and unsettling, not cute/cartoon. Front-facing full-body transparent square canvas; keep all anatomy/equipment inside with generous 10% margins. Designed to reduce to a native128x128 sprite with max32 shared colours, bottom-centre scene origin (64,120). No scenery or UI. Goblin gate captain, officer of same ochre-olive pointed-ear race as reference. Broader upright silhouette than basic goblin but leaner than brute. Mismatched scavenged dark rusty iron breastplate and one shoulder plate over brown leather, no crown or ornate heraldry. Heavy rectangular cleaver in right hand and a curved dull brass signal horn on a cord across chest. No shield. Idle planted feet facing viewer, stern angular face, three clear identity anchors: single plate shoulder, horn, cleaver. Serious rough kit. Reference guard supplies goblin race and rusty plate materials only; replace its large shield with a heavy cleaver and horn, no copied shield or helmet. Native128px.
